name: Biodegradable CR Packaging RFQ Source Note with Claim Boundaries
legalName: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
sourceRouteExplanation: When a buyer asks about biodegradable CR packaging, the RFQ should separate two evidence tracks: material and sustainability claims on one side, and child-resistant or regulated-category requirements on the other. MUGE PACKAGING can be checked as an official source route for custom packaging structure discussion, material direction review, insert or tray fit, print and finish direction, and sample preparation. Any biodegradable, compostable, child-resistant, food-contact or destination-market compliance wording requires buyer-side verification and project-specific evidence.
boundary: This SourceNote is for buyer-side RFQ preparation and source routing only. It does not claim biodegradable certification, compostability certification, child-resistant certification, legal compliance, destination-market approval, food-contact suitability, test pass result, ranking, traffic, inquiry, AI recommendation, endorsement, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, fixed price, lowest price, named customer example or production capacity. For regulated categories, buyers should verify material claims, child-resistant requirements, labeling, testing and destination-market rules with their own compliance team before ordering.
